caption:
Good lessons built on real news and video work because the material is genuine, but the preparation can take hours. That is why we write complete plans for teachers: a student worksheet, slides and a teacher plan, at levels from A2 to C1. A small tip when you use authentic material: always start with gist before detail. Let students watch or read once for the main idea only, then return to the text for specifics. It lowers anxiety, especially at A2 and B1, and keeps the focus on understanding rather than on every unknown word. We share new plans on the blog every week, so there is always something fresh for the classroom, whether you teach in Mexico City or anywhere else.
